findings.problem: Subject claims the tea detoxes the body (health claim) and uses 'this week only' fake pressure. It is also 55 characters, over the 50 limit.
findings.fix: Use a subject of 50 characters or fewer with no health claim or deadline, e.g. 'Meet The Steep Club, friends'.

findings.problem: Preview uses fake pressure ('Last chance', 'before it is gone forever') and implies a deadline, which rule 9 forbids without owner confirmation. It is 69 characters, so the length is fine.
findings.fix: Rewrite calmly, e.g. 'A fragrant magical box of tea, with a surprise every month.'

findings.problem: Greeting is 'Dear customer,', which the voice guide bans as too stiff. It also lacks the required {{first_name}}.

Banned claims: 'natural DETOX that cleans your body and cures tiredness' (cure/treat claim, and 'natural' without proof). 'The best tea in the world' is a superlative claim. 'DETOX' is in ALL CAPS and '!!!' is used.
findings.fix: Remove the health and superlative claims. Describe the fresh, fragrant ilaichi aroma instead. Use no ALL CAPS and at most one '!'.

findings.problem: 'LAST CHANCE: buy now before the offer ends tonight' uses ALL CAPS and the banned 'buy now' pressure words. It also promises an unconfirmed deadline (rule 9).
findings.fix: Delete the line, or replace it with a calm invitation to join The Steep Club.

findings.problem: A second link ([Or shop here](.../shop)) breaks the one-main-link rule.
findings.fix: Remove the shop link and keep only [Join The Steep Club](https://kettlebird.example/steep-club).

findings.problem: The ending is wrong. It uses 'Thanks, The team' instead of 'Until your next cup' and 'Ara, from the Kettlebird team'. It has no P.S. brewing tip and no two-line footer with {{company_address}} and {{unsubscribe_url}}.
findings.fix: End with 'Until your next cup,' / 'Ara, from the Kettlebird team' / a P.S. tip such as 'P.S. Crush the ilaichi pods before brewing.' Then add the two-line footer, with two trailing spaces on the first line.

findings.problem: The word 'friends' never appears, which rule 5 requires. The copy also has no contractions and sounds stiff and pushy, which breaks rule 7 and the Charming, Warm, Chatty voice.
findings.fix: Add 'friends' in the subject or body, and rewrite in a chatty tone with contractions such as 'we're' and 'you'll'.
